feedback.end: Ouch! That’s too loud, turn down the volume!

instruction.text: Put the headphones over the girl’s ears.

atoms.text: Sounds can be loud or quiet. The level of loudness is called volume. Let’s take a closer look at what volume means!

instruction.text: Which sound is louder? Choose the correct answer.

feedback.end: For the louder sound, the volume has been turned up. For the quieter sound, the volume has been turned down.

instruction.text: Mrs Harbor is standing in front of the stage. Two musicians are playing at the same volume. Which one will she hear the loudest? Find and select the correct musician.

feedback.end: The musician with the blue guitar is standing closest to Mrs Harbor. She hears him play the loudest even though they are both playing at the same volume. Let’s find out why that is.

instruction.text: Find and select the sound waves coming from the musician in the back.

feedback.end: The sound waves coming from the guitarist in the back have to travel further. Some of the sound gets lost on the way. This is why Mrs Harbor will hear him more quietly than the guitarist closer to her.
